title: Strategy Card UIs
description: The new layouts for three strategy card primaries: Construction's step label on the planet bar, the Trade replenish table, and Imperial's objectives overview with the Mecatol or draw-a-secret outcome card. Synthetic gallery fixtures, not captured engine states.

shots.heading: Construction: first structure
shots.caption: The planet bar carries a 'Structure 1 of 2' badge; after picking Jord on the map it offers a PDS or a space dock and shows what is already there.

shots.heading: Construction: second structure
shots.caption: The second placement reads 'Structure 2 of 2 · PDS only', and only PDS options are offered.

shots.heading: Trade: replenish another player
shots.caption: After the Trade primary's own gain, each eligible seat is a row with its commodities now and after a replenish (for example 1/6 → 6, +5), one Replenish button per seat, and Done to stop.

shots.heading: Imperial: holding Mecatol Rex
shots.caption: The objectives overview as before, with an always-visible card saying the Imperial primary then gives +1 VP because you hold Mecatol Rex. Scoring an objective stays optional (Decline).

shots.heading: Imperial: no Mecatol Rex
shots.caption: Without Mecatol Rex the same card says you draw a secret objective afterwards and shows your hand (2/3 held). The point and the draw are alternatives, never both.
